limitations: Applies only to even spherical-harmonic degrees on the 120 unoriented E8 root lines; does not classify oriented odd-degree or mixed-degree evaluation. A classical general characteristic-matrix identity supplies the formal starting point, so unrecognized prior specialization remains possible.
scientific_integrity: The result is a self-review mathematical proof check, not independent certification. The polynomial cutoff is analytic, and finite graph parameters are verified by exhaustive integer enumeration. No publication priority is claimed.
title: Reentrant harmonic-sampling obstruction on the \(E_8\) projective root lines
